title: Reel: the nine signature kills, one isolated cop each, 48 px/m real time, labelled
note: Solo lab (--sig-solo=-36,2): Rivet and one guard on open course floor, no dummy rows. The camera stops at the course's west edge, so Rivet sits left of centre. Electro: the first round stuns, the second kills (the gun is 60 dmg; REQUEST 12 -> gunplay for a charged shot).

title: Katana: two clearly separated halves part sideways over the blood fan (64 px/m, 0.4x)
note: Iteration 7: the halves leave across the cut (SPLIT_FOLLOW 0.6 -> 0.25) at 2.4-3 m/s and rest about 2 m apart, both in frame. Before: the cut was hidden in a crowd and the halves flew off together.

title: Electro: the skeleton flash, 12 consecutive 60 fps frames (64 px/m)
note: Iteration 7: cream bones on ink held 4 frames in a jagged cream zap burst (1.6 m), then strobing 2 of 6 frames, then the stiff drop. Before: 2 of every 5 frames at 1.3 m under the arcs; only the arcs read.

title: Electro: convulsion, held X-ray flash, stiff drop, collar smoke (64 px/m, 0.4x)
note: One isolated cop. The kill round is the second (the first only stuns).

title: Plasma sword: two cauterised halves with glowing edges, no blood (64 px/m, 0.4x)
note: Same split as the katana; the cut edges glow and cool, no spray.

title: Rocket launcher: one cop blown into six parts, spray, splat, scorch (64 px/m, 0.4x)
note: Isolated. Kill-frame cost: the cut is 0.9 ms; the 74 ms spike came from reprinting every leftover and is now 20.5 ms worst over 24 kills (CONTENDED, cost-rocket-it7-*.json).

title: Chainsaw: the grind (held, shaking, spurting) then a straight split (64 px/m, 0.4x)
note: Isolated cop; the halves part sideways.

title: Ray gun: rings eat the body into a glowing dust pile and the empty uniform (64 px/m, 0.4x)
note: Isolated cop. Still a first pass (pile colour, the ray mark on top: REQUEST 11).

title: Flamethrower: ablaze, charred silhouette, crumble to ash (64 px/m, 0.4x)
note: Isolated cop; the first burst lands off him, the second sets him alight.

title: Homing shard gun (FIRST PASS): the cop freezes on the shard, then bursts into parts in a ring of red mist (64 px/m, 0.4x)
note: Kill #10, data row on the gib path with a 36-tick hold. The shards themselves do not show stuck in the body yet, and the red ring lands at the hit, before the pop.

title: Mini-nuke (FIRST PASS): the cop vaporised to a charcoal shadow that stays where he stood (48 px/m)
note: Kill #11. Gunplay's 6 s fire patch covers the shadow until it burns out (watch the end). Hub clip with the dummies: clips/mini-nuke-vaporise-hub-48ppm-11s.mp4 (22 vaporised; reads as a fire carpet).

title: Hand cannon: blown off his feet, flies back, slides on a smear, cap spins off (64 px/m, 0.4x)
note: Isolated cop; the body lands near the right edge of the 64 px/m frame (see the 48 px/m reel).
